```{r}
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
stickiness_data <- read_csv("STICKNESS.csv")
```

```{r}
stickiness_data <- stickiness_data %>%
  mutate(month = factor(month, levels = unique(month)))

ggplot(stickiness_data, aes(x = month, y = Stickiness_percent, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(color = "#0073C2", size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "#0073C2", size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Monthly Stickiness (DAU/MAU) Trend - 2022") +
  theme_minimal()
```
